subject: 15% Off Foam in September
body_content:
Last chance to use your discount
View this email in your browser

Refresh For September - 15% Off Foam

 
From getting your campervan ready for the road to tackling home improvements, upholstery projects and specialist applications, the right foam can take your next project further.

At GB Foam Direct, we cut foam to your exact requirements for campervan seating and beds, replacement sofa cushions, mattresses, outdoor furniture, packaging, acoustic treatment and much more. Choose from a wide range of foam grades, shapes and sizes, all cut to order at our Buckinghamshire factory.

Wherever your next project takes you, use code FRESH15 at the checkout to save 15% throughout September.

With 50 years of foam expertise and next working day delivery as standard throughout the majority of the UK, getting exactly what you need couldn't be easier.
 
Use Code: FRESH15

Made to Measure

 
Not every project comes in a standard size. That’s why we make it easy to order foam cut to the exact dimensions you need, whether you’re replacing an existing cushion or working from a completely new design.

Choose from 25 shapes using our online foam cut to size service, or provide your own template for more complex requirements. Simply enter your measurements, choose your foam and we’ll take care of the cutting.

Need some guidance before ordering? Our team can help with everything from choosing the right foam grade to working out the measurements for your project.
Foam Inspiration
Not sure what to use your discount on? Here's some inspiration. Whatever foam you need, we can provide it. Get in touch with our team to find out more.
Upholstery Foam
A wide selection of foam sheets for all uses.
Buy Now
Campervan Foam
All the foam your campervan needs.
Buy Now
Outdoor Cushions
Relax in the sun on our comfy outdoor foam.
Buy Now
Caravan Foam
Perfect for making your caravan cosy.
Buy Now
Sofa Cushion Foam
Banish those saggy old sofa cushions for good.
Buy Now
Boat Foam
Sail to GB Foam Direct for quality boat foam.
Buy Now
We've made it even more simple to replace your sofa cushions with GB Foam Direct! Now, you can watch our sofa cushion-measuring guide to help ensure you always take accurate measurements.
FEATURED TESTIMONIAL
 
We are a large Fortune 500 company and had a great experience using GB Foam's services. We will continue to use the company going forward. Excellent turn-around times and accurately made products.

- Pete Jahn
